value.signature: fn commit_admitted_epoch (& mut self , input : & AdmittedEpoch) -> Result < bool , StorageError >

review.body: { let result = self . commit_epoch_inner (input , & mut | _ | Ok (())) ; classified (result) }
review.item_premise: The memory transaction accepts only an admitted carrier, checks public selections and immutable vintages, and publishes a complete candidate or a fieldless refusal. All memory fields contain public package bytes and projections, never a Session or secret; full arguments and results are recorded and no computation reads observation. PostgreSQL writes and independent re-admission remain held.
